messages:
maria: @here Weeknight surge rehearsal scheduled Tue 2026-03-31 02:00-03:30 UTC. We'll simulate ~3x token load for 45m to validate SLOs, fallback behavior, and cache warmup. Please read the plan below and ack if you can participate.

ashok: Ack. Which regions are in-scope?

maria: Primary region: us-west-1. Failover target: us-east-1. Small canary to eu-west-1 to validate cross-region routing. Traffic shape: short bursts + steady ramp.

rachel: Will KV-cache prefill run before the spike? p99 often jumps when cache is cold.

maria: Yes — prefill job starts 01:45 UTC (15m before). Prefill script snippet:    
```
# prefill prefix list
python tools/prefill.py --prefixes /configs/prefill/weekday-night.json --concurrency 50 --region us-west-1
```

sre-lead: Rollback/abort criteria: p99 latency > 2.0s for 10m OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> abort rehearsal and route traffic to stable pool. No infra or model rollouts during the window.

devops: Runbook posted: https://confluence.redwood/sre/weeknight-surge-rehearsal. I'll tag the jobs and create a monitoring dashboard link in the runbook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please ensure correct pager rotations for Tue 02:00 UTC. If you need coverage swaps, update the oncall calendar now.

ashok: Loadgen command for control plane:    
```
traffic-gen --target https://api.redwood-infer.test/v1/generate \n  --qps 1200 --duration 45m --payload samples/short_prompt.json \n  --region us-west-1 --concurrency 300
```

maria: Added loadgen config and expected baselines to the runbook. Also: DO NOT push model weight changes or quantization rollouts during the window. :lock:

rachel: I'll take KV and edge cache dashboards, monitor hit-rate and cold-miss ratio. If warm hit rate < 85% after prefill, we pause load and extend prefill. tagging @sre-lead

sre-lead: Agreed. If we hit any of the rollback triggers we'll announce in this thread and execute the fallback policy. Control-plane engineer will stand by for traffic-script quick changes.

maria: Quick notes for responders:
- Observability targets: p50/p90/p99 latency panels, request success rate, cpu/gpu util, kv hit-rate.
- Alerting: default SLO alerts enabled; ephemeral test alerts suppressed for noise.
- Communication: keep this thread for status updates only during the window.

devops: I'll push an annotated ticket to the incident board and pin it to #eng-sre 30m before start.

ashok: If anyone needs to run the prefill manually: use the dry-run flag first: `--dry-run` then `--apply`.

maria: Thanks all — please post a quick ack if you can attend. If you can't, add your replacement. :thumbsup:
